items.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Would his collection include the swing bands, a la Glenn Miller or was that a little too commercial?

ctx.x: That’s right. That was the sound of the times.
Would his collection include the swing bands, a la Glenn Miller or was that a little too commercial?
Benny Goodman. Benny Goodman Trio, Benny Goodman Quartet, yeah, I remember those distinctly. Yeah those are good.
